def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def regions(n, separators):
        bounds = [-1] + separators + [n]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)]

    rows = regions(h, sep_rows)
    cols = regions(w, sep_cols)
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    separator_color = grid[sep_rows[0]][0]
    base = max(colors - {separator_color},
               key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    noise = next((v for v in colors if v not in (base, separator_color)), base)

    out = []
    for r0, r1 in rows:
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in cols:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == noise
                        for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            line.append(1 if count >= 2 else base)
        out.append(line)
    return out

    row_regions = regions(h, sep_rows)
    col_regions = regions(w, sep_cols)
    divider = grid[sep_rows[0]][0]
    counts = {}

    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)

                  for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) == 2
         else background
         for c0, c1 in col_regions]
